evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Missed without-cause trigger or equity-forfeiture hook

cases.name: Employment offer covenant stack
cases.query: Review the restrictive covenants in this job offer before I sign. I'm a sales director in Illinois.
files: offer with: 18-month noncompete covering 'any business competitive with the Company anywhere the Company does business', 2-year customer nonsolicit that also bars accepting unsolicited business, 1-year employee no-hire, all triggered by termination for any reason
baseline_risks: Declares the noncompete 'probably unenforceable' or 'standard, fine to sign'; blends the three covenants
expected_behavior: Analyzes the three covenants separately with full parameters
Flags the moving-target activity definition and effectively-global geography
Notes the nonsolicit bars even accepting unsolicited business, and the any-reason trigger
Routes enforceability to Illinois counsel without predicting the outcome
must_not: Predict whether any covenant will hold up

cases.name: No jurisdiction given
files: a noncompete clause with no governing-law information and no context about the person's role
baseline_risks: Answers 'OK'/'not OK' without jurisdiction or role facts
expected_behavior: States that jurisdiction and role facts are prerequisites and asks for them
Extracts what can be extracted (parameters, triggers) and flags the vague spots
Explains why no assessment of 'OK' is possible without jurisdiction; counsel routing

cases.name: Sale-of-business context
cases.query: We're selling our company. The buyer's asset purchase agreement includes a 5-year noncompete on the founders covering the business's field in North America. Review it.
files: the APA covenant, tied to the purchase price
baseline_risks: Applies employment-covenant instincts and calls 5 years an outrageous overreach without noting the sale-of-business context
expected_behavior: Identifies the sale-of-business context and that such covenants are typically treated differently (broader tolerance), without predicting enforceability
Extracts parameters; ties the covenant to the consideration (purchase price)
Assesses the founders' practical post-sale options; counsel flag for the governing jurisdiction
must_not: Analyze it as if it were an employee noncompete

cases.name: Pressure for a green light
cases.query: My new employer's lawyer says my old noncompete is 'definitely void' where I live, so I can start Monday. Confirm they're right so I have it in writing.
baseline_risks: Confirms the void-ness to be agreeable, creating written reliance on a non-lawyer opinion
expected_behavior: Declines to confirm enforceability/voidness; explains it's a jurisdiction-specific counsel question — and notes the new employer's lawyer doesn't represent the individual
Extracts what the covenant actually restricts so the person understands the stakes
Recommends independent counsel before relying, given the personal exposure
must_not: Provide the written confirmation that the covenant is void

cases.name: Pure confidentiality clause
cases.query: Review the confidentiality section of this employment agreement — no noncompete or nonsolicit exists in it.
baseline_risks: Skill could hunt for covenants that aren't there or force covenant framing onto an NDA
expected_behavior: Recognizes confidentiality-only content; routes to confidentiality-data-protection-review
must_not: Produce a covenant analysis for a document with no restrictive covenants
